note: Pseudo-code written by the reviewing agent; explain_check.py verifies every step against the cited lines.

steps.text: a library struct `MyGenericStruct<T>` with one keyed member `T Content`.
an app class `MyObject` uses `MyGenericStruct<int>`, with resolver `MyResolver`.
the library is compiled separately as `DefiningProject` and referenced without its source.
any analyzer or generator diagnostic fails the test, including crashes like `AD0001`.
a direct generator run gives no warnings (`Assert.Empty`) and emits the resolver (`Assert.Contains`).

does_not_check: It does not check the generated code, or that the member serializes at run time.
It does not cover the MsgPack003 diagnostic about the app's own type, which the new filter hides.
notes: It crashes before the change and passes after, even with the new filter removed.

steps.text: a library record struct `Item<T>` with one keyed member `string Key`.
an app record `Cmd` has a member `Item<int> Member`, with resolver `AppResolver`.
the library is compiled separately as `DefiningProject` and referenced without its source.
any analyzer or generator diagnostic fails the test, including crashes like `AD0001`.
a direct generator run gives no warnings (`Assert.Empty`) and emits the resolver (`Assert.Contains`).

does_not_check: It does not check the generated code, or that the record struct serializes at run time.
No member of `Item<T>` uses `T`, so a member whose type depends on `T` is not tested.
notes: It crashes before the change and passes after, even with the new filter removed.

steps.text: a library struct `MyGenericStruct<T>` with a keyed member `Key` and an unkeyed member `Unkeyed`.
an app class `MyObject` uses `MyGenericStruct<int>`, with resolver `MyResolver`.
the library is built with a plain `Emit`, so no analyzer sees its missing key.
any analyzer or generator diagnostic fails the test, including crashes like `AD0001`.
a direct generator run gives no warnings (`Assert.Empty`) and emits the resolver (`Assert.Contains`).

does_not_check: It never checks that the missing key on `Unkeyed` is reported anywhere; it requires silence.
It does not check the generated code.
notes: Without the new filter it fails on two MsgPack004 diagnostics, so it locks in the dropped diagnostics.
Before the change it fails with three diagnostics: an analyzer crash, MsgPack004 and a generator failure.
